title: Set response maps: empty-vs-null inconsistency across handlers
description: RFC 8620 §5.3 implies empty created/updated/destroyed maps should be null. Mailbox/set (mailbox.rs:658-686) correctly returns null when empty. But Email/set (email.rs:559-571) returns {} for empty created/updated and [] for empty destroyed, not null. Submission/set and Identity/set also return {} or [] when empty. A client checking 'if resp.created \!= null' would see {} as truthy and wrongly think objects were created. Rewrite to use null for empty maps consistently.
